headline: Chip Stocks Face Investor Confidence Crisis Despite Sustained Big Tech Spending
summary: Semiconductor stocks are experiencing a crisis of confidence as investors question the sustainability of chip demand, though analysts point out that major tech companies continue heavy spending.
why: The semiconductor industry serves as the backbone for modern computing, AI, and consumer electronics, making capital expenditure trends by large technology firms a critical leading indicator for global tech sector performance.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Market sentiment and spending trends directly influence the semiconductor sector.
